audit_items.proof_trace: The code constructs proofs array using exactly numberOfColumns iterations (L156-163) but trusts kzg.ComputeCells() to return matching count without validation (L150-153). If the C-KZG library returns len(cells) != numberOfColumns due to malformed blob input, CellsAndProofs is constructed with mismatched array lengths, violating the invariant before bounds checks at L227-232 can prevent it.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker provides malformed blob via P2P causing ckzg4844.ComputeCells() to return incorrect cell count (e.g., 127 instead of 128), while providing 128 valid proofs. Code creates CellsAndProofs with len(Cells)=127 and len(Proofs)=128, violating the property's requirement that each blob produces exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs.
